visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact list of recent posts with small square thumbnails
visualCharacteristics.description: 60x60 square thumbnail left, small blue linked title and small grey date right, hairline dividers between items.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per post: cell 1 = thumbnail image, cell 2 = linked title, optional date paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for sidebar "Recent posts" style link lists. For full teasers with excerpts use cards-teaser-list.
